text:
Priya: Quick check — candidate (SRE IC4) scheduled Thurs 3pm PT. Proposed panel: @Samir, @Elena, @Maya, @Aisha. Need: scribe + debrief lead + confirm rubric weighting. Can folks confirm availability and who can scribe? Also we should ask candidate consent to record.
Samir: I’m available at 3pm. Can be debrief lead if nobody else wants it. Not great to scribe and lead tho — prefer lead. :thumbsup:
Elena: I can join but I need to jump at 3:30 PT for another sync. I can cover system-design questions during first 30m.
Aisha: I can make it fully. Agree we should bump system-design weight given infra focus. Not scribing.
Maya: I can scribe and capture notes + eval scores in the form. If Samir takes debrief lead that works.
Priya: ok plan then — Samir = debrief lead, Maya = scribe, Elena partial, Aisha + Priya full. Quick rubric change proposal: SD 40%, Coding 35%, Communication 25%. Any objections?
Aisha: fine by me.
Samir: fine. Also flagging timezone — candidate is in CET; calendar invite should show both PT and CET.
Priya: noted. recruiting will confirm candidate consent; interview-bot can post a recording consent template here so I can DM.
interview-bot: Recording consent template: "During this interview we record audio/video for internal hiring debrief only. If you do not consent we will not record — please reply 'I consent' or 'I do not consent'." Use in DM or calendar description.
Priya: I’ll update the calendar and add the consent text to the invite description. Also adding a 15-min debrief slot immediately after the interview for quick score normalization.
Maya: calendar text for invite (copyable):

```
Interview: Candidate Name — SRE (IC4)
When: Thurs, 3:00pm PT / 12:00am CET (candidate local)
Panel: Samir, Elena, Maya, Aisha, Priya
Recording consent: "During this interview we record audio/video for internal hiring debrief only. Reply 'I consent' or 'I do not consent'."
Debrief: 15m immediately after
Scribe: Maya
Eval link: https://evals.company/review/XXXXX
```

Samir: looks good. Maya can you own posting scores to the eval link within 30m after call?
Maya: yep will post within 30m.
Priya: perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll ping recruiting and update the eval rubric weights in the form. :raised_hands:
